# Component Pouch (`equipment:component-pouch`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 2 gp | **Weight:** 1 lb.

A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.
